HEADLINE: Likhami Consulting Ltdhas informed BSE that the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled on 29/10/2026 ,inter alia, to consider and approve Pursuant to provisions of ....
MORE:
Likhami Consulting Ltdhas informed BSE that the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled on 29/10/2026 ,inter alia, to consider and approve Pursuant to provisions of Regulation 29 of SEBI LODR ,2015, a meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company will be held on Thursday, 29th October, 2026 at 12:30 P.M. at its Registered Office of the Company to inter-alia consider and approve the following business as under:- 
1.To consider and approve Unaudited Financial Results for the 02st quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. 
2.To consider and approve Limited Review Report by the Statutory Auditors on Unaudited Financial Results for the 02st quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. 
3.To discuss any other matters with the permission of the Chairman.
Our letter dated 23rd September, 2026 the trading window shall remain closed for all the Promoters, Directors, Key Managerial Personnel, Connected Persons and Designated persons/ Employees of the Company and their relatives from 01st October, 2026 and shall remain closed to 31st October, 2026 (both days inclusive).
PFA.
